snippet.title: Ghost of Yōtei Complete Edition - Echoes of Sekigahara Narrative Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
Ghost of Yōtei Echoes of Sekigahara is a brand-new story expansion that delves into Atsu's past, along with her experiences during the Battle of Sekigahara. Explore a whole new area of Ezo, complete with new enemies and more. Diversify your fighting style with a new weapon type to master, alongside new armor types, new cosmetics and more. 
 
Ghost of Yōtei Complete Edition is available to purchase today*.
Echoes of Sekigahara and Most Wanted available October 1, 2026**†. 
 
Learn More: https://www.playstation.com/games/ghost-of-yotei/ 
 
*Digital version only. Physical version available October 1, 2026
**Available via patch v2.0 or later. Internet connection and account for PlayStation® required to download. 
†Available October 2 in some territories including Asia, Australia, and New Zealand.
